activities.description: Two animated gloves, one blue and one red, are presented as representing two different chiral molecules (enantiomers).

Many gloves are shown floating, representing a solution of mixed enantiomers. Robotic hands emerge and selectively pick up only the blue gloves, representing a chiral surface selectively attracting one type of enantiomer.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The use of gloves as an analogy makes the abstract concept of chirality more accessible and engaging for a wider audience.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual shift from two gloves to many gloves, increasing the complexity.
Introduction of robotic hands adds a dynamic element and highlights the concept of selective separation.

The first storyline introduces the scientific concept of chirality, enantiomers, and their separation through both animation and real lab applications. The second storyline shifts focus to a specific research project exploring chiral monolayers and their potential applications.
